text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I'm in a sports store at the
mall
when I come across Silence Suzuka
and a few
others.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All righty! And we're here—the fabled
Shangri-la!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What are you on about? Don't you
forget, we've
come here to help Suzuka
select a new pair of
shoes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Suzuka. Are you picky about
anything when
it comes to shoes?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well...
I guess my first concern is usually
finding the right size. But that's just a
matter of trying
them on...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I prefer them flexible and
soft... I like to
feel my feet make contact
with the ground, so the soles should be
on the thin side... And then... Um...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Dang, Suzuka! I knew you'd be part'cular
'bout
your shoes!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Lookit these beauties!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Feast your eyes on this legendary find!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Stop it...
Those are clearly roller skates! And
what's with those odd feathers sewn
on the
ankles?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh... How do you think they're used?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What?! You don't know what roller
skates are?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, that's not what I meant... I was
wondering
if they might have any use for
training or not.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
C'mon now. Learn to trust your senses.
Look at the feathers. Clearly they're
meant to send you soaring beyond the
clouds! Just imagine the incredible
scenery you'd get to see.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Incredible scenery...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Since we're here, you might as
well try them
on! Right, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What?! ...Um, yes, I suppose so...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Okay, I'll give them a try.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka skates slowly around the
shoe
store. As she turns a corner...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, umm, how am I supposed to stop?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: S-Suzuka?! Wait!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was close! When Suzuka
picked up speed down that slope, then
jumped and performed a triple axel
midair, I thought I was
going to faint.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Who knew Suzuka possessed such
power... What fools you are, Spe and
McQueen. You've gone
and broken her
forbidden seal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! You started it! Good grief...
Sorry
about all this, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'm fine. Things got a little
hairy, but
it was... entertaining. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Thank goodness you had fun,
then!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. As I thought, there's never a dull
moment
with you guys. I really mean it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All righty! Let's keep the fun going and
continue
our search for Suzuka's perfect
shoes!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks. Okay, then. Shall we—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Holy moly! You won't believe it, I've
struck gold
again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Which can only mean you've found some
other
oddity—oh wait, those look rather
nice.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, duh. Everyone knows that when
shopping for shoes, you're supposed to
choose something
flexible, soft, and
with soles on the thin side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What?! You just repeated what Suzuka
said in the
beginning, word for word!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Suzuka, come here for a second! I
found
these in just the right size—oh,
and they have
carrot decals!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Okay, I'm coming.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Look at all the choices I have...
I'd never have
noticed this many if I came here
alone. But thanks
to you all...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Now I'm curious to try them on. I
wonder what kind of scenery I'll be able
to see... running
with the shoes everyone
chose.
